items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: When I got transferred to the band, and Vodery was the bandmaster. And he used to rehearse us, and you know what I played?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I met Bill Vodery here in New York, when I went in the Army in 1918, he was bandmaster.
And I wasn't in the band at the time, I was in headquarters' company. When I got transferred to the band, and Vodery was the bandmaster. And he used to rehearse us, and you know what I played?
